newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Aug retail, catering see 4pct real drop.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Aug retail, catering see 4pct real drop.

text.p: Turnover in Hungary's retail and catering was four percent lower in real terms in the first eight months of 1996 than in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Wednesday.
Retail and catering turnover totalled 1,747 billion forints in the January-August period, up 20 percent in nominal terms from the corresponding period of 1995, the KSH said in a statement.
Retail sales, amounting to 1,622 billion forints in the January-August period, dropped three percent in real terms, while the turnover of catering units fell by 11 percent.
A Ministry of Industry and Trade official said last week that the country's retail turnover for the whole year could reach last year's level in real terms.
